purpose: Find a residual, operationally meaningful decision gap after public candidate coverage and probability diagnostics; do not promise G2.

target_contracts.legacy: Keep original 88-state denominator; one additional root15/cid127/clock28844 diagnostic is separate. Old guarantees apply only to old action/observation/model/continuation targets.
target_contracts.expanded: Build a new common menu and observation contract from public information. Recollect/freeze its own state panel. Never transplant old certificates automatically.
target_contracts.conditional_evaluation: Root P0 physical law; legal local observations; future remote frames frozen unless a valid joint model is separately specified; actual cheap W continuation.
target_contracts.actual_replay: Archived physical endpoints, declared MCT, original logical publication clock. New hard-wall experiments are a separate later contract.
target_contracts.deployment_claim: No deployment or arbitrary conditional calibration claim follows from the current audit.

proposed_files.role: Immutable inputs, target law, menus, information, policies, sample budget and stop rules.
Public-rule closure of earlier boarding points for existing-menu trips, with no access to future actual labels.
Old M/O; old M/new O; new M/new O; followed by same-new-domain strong controls.
All eligible catch-window events with full denominators, cancellation and missingness.
Freeze legal conditional challenger before independent evaluation.
Common physical worlds, isolated policy histories, separate planner/evaluation randomness.
Separate fixed-policy value, forced-actions, and root-bounds-only APIs; no novelty claim.
Retain positive, negative and unresolved cells; define every denominator and target.
Mechanism and closest-method difference, written before broad algorithm construction.

work_packages.objective: Turn the root4 post-hoc coverage witness into one public, uniform rule.
actions: Retain all old actions. Enumerate earlier boarding connections on trips already represented in the remaining menu, using graph connectivity, same-trip identity, pickup/dropoff, destination or existing continuation and declared MCT.
Do not discard a connection solely because planned departure is before planned ready. A support filter must be admissible under the declared physical law; tiny positive probability is not zero.
The candidate builder receives no future actual event times. Verify endpoint coverage after candidate construction and retain incomplete outcomes as bounds.
At all 72 old roots run old M/old O, old M/new O, new M/new O with cheap W. Use a common predeclared station observation union.
Run optimized full rollout and the relevant cheap controls on the same expanded domain when evaluating residual planning gains. Recollect a new public-state panel.
Charge menu preparation, posterior construction, observations, policy evaluation and cache work. Retain regressions and the old 72-root denominator.
work_packages.stop: If ordinary public coverage absorbs the useful signal, retain a stronger baseline and do not create a new main algorithm around this mechanism.

work_packages.effort: 2-3 working days; parallel only where inputs are frozen
work_packages.objective: Determine whether the relevant catch-window probabilities and cost rankings are credible.
actions: For all prospectively eligible opportunities record upstream catch, downstream catch after random arrival+MCT, same-trip joint events, cancellation and unavailable labels.
Retain every event partition and its contribution to paired action loss; physical catch feasibility is different from actual policy boarding.
Predeclare groups such as missing/aged forecasts, MCT differences and number of downstream options from development inputs, not from later winners.
Check forecast event probabilities on separately selected new days/operational events, with a fixed acquisition and inclusion rule. Infer at the day/independent-incident level.
Inspect concrete platform-pair MCT provenance when making real-world claims. Do not adjust buffers to make results favorable.
work_packages.stop: If probabilities or the operational contract dominate the sign reversal, fix the model/contract and re-freeze before algorithmic claims.

work_packages.effort: 2-3 working days only if residual decision signals remain
work_packages.objective: Find a feasible conditional improvement without first solving full V*.
work_packages.identity: Jcheap - J* >= Jcheap - Jeta for the same history, law, objective and admissible information.
actions: Select eta from old development data or a public deterministic rule; freeze it before generating confirmation worlds.
Start with one alternate legal root action followed by cheap W. A full rollout controller is a distinct policy and requires its own complete evaluation.
Use StableTripWorlds-style global dated trip ranks. Each policy gets its own mutable history and sees only legal observations along its trajectory.
Separate evaluation randomness from any planner randomness. Do not inject archived future remote frames into newly sampled worlds without a coherent joint model.
Use predetermined complete sample stages, valid multiple-testing/optional-stopping control and a fixed total CPU cap. If a stage is incomplete, keep it unresolved or use a valid time-uniform method.
Preserve the legacy 88 + separate 1 diagnostic and the newly expanded-domain panel as different targets.
After a state-level signal, test a uniform causal policy on full journeys; do not average conditional state gains and call them trip gains.

statistical_draft.rule: Choose total CPU cap and any practically relevant effect threshold before opening confirmation results, based on cost-only pilot and operational scale.
statistical_draft.preferred_bounds: Bounded empirical Bernstein with error allocated across all declared states/candidates/looks, or a valid confidence sequence.
statistical_draft.ordinary_normal_intervals: Descriptive only for old banks and selected actions.
statistical_draft.external_validity: New random worlds at old states do not create new real-world dates.

work_packages.stop: Positive proves only a fixed-model conditional gap; nonpositive or unresolved does not prove cheap optimal. Do not respond by building another full-value oracle.

work_packages.effort: At most 3 working days for a research decision
work_packages.objective: Decide whether a residual gap warrants a new algorithmic contribution.
actions: Test whether single-target, paired-target, limited lookahead, same-domain snapshot/replanning or a uniform inexpensive rule absorbs the gap.
Build a small causal instance family preserving the identified mechanism and independently enumerate it.
State one candidate new result: a sufficient decision state, a useful economical action-difference bound, or a tractable special inner problem.
Account for the cost of constructing and checking the structure, not only solving after it is given.
Compare with ordinary dependency analysis/variable elimination, optimized rollout and appropriate anytime DP/search using shared primitives.
Stop if the benefit is entirely explained by ordinary cache, dominance, subset DP, generic information relaxation or a manually selected case.
work_packages.stop: No clear residual mechanism plus distinct structural contribution means close the current algorithm-centered route.

work_packages.objective: Establish G2 computation/algorithm value and separately G3 external evidence.
actions: Evaluate time-to-the-same quality and quality under truly equal hard execution budgets; report CPU, wall, tail costs, deadline misses and fallback.
Include root-bounds-only and policy-only reference tasks; count all preparation, failed gate checks and maintenance.
Freeze mechanism-defined applicability, new dates, OD sampling, joins, missingness and primary outcomes before reading confirmation results.
Report clustered day/incident uncertainty, negative strata and conditional scope. Do not claim arbitrary-condition risk calibration or universal dominance.

allowed_engineering_only: Single/last observation outcome fast path avoiding unused child ChainLaw.
Separate fixed-policy and forced-action evaluation APIs.
Root-bound-only baseline with measured setup cost.
Small profile-guided improvements only; persistent terminal tasks are optional and not a default new route.
do_not_treat_as_new_or_unfinished: V50 four-first-car cap removal and menu/observation comparison.
V54 root budget reflow / cutoff reduction.
V55 terminal decomposition and strong-control completion.
Generic shared interfaces, caches, subset DP, or per-trip martingale penalties.
